label: Iskratel Innbox X24 XGS-PON ONT
description: XGS-PON ONT (EcoNet EN7580, MIPS interAptiv 2C/4T @ 1.3 GHz, Linux 4.4.115) with a single multi-gigabit 10/5/2.5/1GBase-T LAN port (an optional second GE port in a dedicated version) and no Wi-Fi; symmetric 9.953 Gbit/s XGS-PON on SC/APC (ITU-T G.9807 Class N1/N2/E1), managed over web UI, telnet or SSH.
